protocol.baseline_selection: named before evaluation; no best-on-test selection
protocol.research_comparator_rule: predeclared EMER-like and CMR-like comparisons must each satisfy research gates; neither comparator is selected from test results
protocol.cold_threshold_source: caller-supplied training-fitted threshold; config.cold_quantile is not evaluated on test
protocol.hypervolume: common random samples in shared [0,1]^M maximize-utility cube; unavailable if an objective has no coverage
protocol.hypervolume_uncertainty: reported standard error describes Monte Carlo integration only, not sampling or training uncertainty
protocol.regret: absolute positive utility shortfall of candidate coordinate-wise best over the fixed preference grid versus named baseline coordinate-wise best; not oracle or per-preference regret
protocol.cold_metric: mean conditional cold-relevance NDCG across preferences and covered positive objectives; uncovered objectives are excluded and their coverage is reported
protocol.controllability: Spearman across the shared preference grid; constant achieved utility uses zero by convention

paired_user_bootstrap.note: Paired percentile intervals, conditional on fixed fitted checkpoints and preference grid; no hypervolume data interval is estimated.

evidence.provenance_basis: validated input manifest; upstream evidence remains auditable
